summary: Build a read-only, human-in-the-loop RAG incident chatbot with a vanilla JavaScript chat frontend and a Python FastAPI backend. The backend retrieves cited runbooks and operational evidence from PostgreSQL with pgvector, then uses a configurable Azure OpenAI GPT-4.1 deployment to produce structured diagnoses and clearly labeled recommendations without executing remediation.

questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Incident Analysis API.
questions.answer: POST /api/incidents/analyze accepts an incident description plus optional service and time-window filters; deterministic pgvector runbook retrieval and parameterized read-only log/metric queries; bounded, injection-resistant evidence context; configurable Azure OpenAI GPT-4.1 deployment (document default azure/gpt-4.1); structured diagnosis, confidence, cited evidence, and clearly labeled recommended human actions; no remediation execution, write SQL, or Azure mutations; audit-safe request IDs; GET /health; retries, timeouts, and non-sensitive telemetry; migrations, sample data, and focused unit/integration tests.
questions.rationale: These backend capabilities and safeguards are explicitly required by the user.
questions.recommendedChoice: POST /api/incidents/analyze accepts an incident description plus optional service and time-window filters; deterministic pgvector runbook retrieval and parameterized read-only log/metric queries; bounded, injection-resistant evidence context; configurable Azure OpenAI GPT-4.1 deployment (document default azure/gpt-4.1); structured diagnosis, confidence, cited evidence, and clearly labeled recommended human actions; no remediation execution, write SQL, or Azure mutations; audit-safe request IDs; GET /health; retries, timeouts, and non-sensitive telemetry; migrations, sample data, and focused unit/integration tests.
